claim: Gafson et al. studied PBMC RNA-seq in relapsing-remitting MS patients starting dimethyl fumarate, with baseline, 6-week, and 15-month samples and NEDA-4 response labels; early responder-associated transcriptome changes were reported at 6 weeks.
future_grounding_route: Use only as a sharper external source record until the underlying paired expression and labels are ingested through the frozen V42/V44 validation harness.

project_finding_reference.finding_id: Bounded APC/HLA-II early treatment-response monitoring scalar

project_use: Sharper external context for V50 reassessment of DMF treatment-response transcriptomic specificity; not validation of the V22 scalar.
relationship_note: The source directly matches the paired DMF PBMC transcriptome and NEDA-4 response setting, but it does not by itself assert the project's APC/HLA-II scalar or frozen threshold.

source.citation: Gafson et al. Mononuclear cell transcriptome changes associated with dimethyl fumarate in MS. Neurology: Neuroimmunology & Neuroinflammation. 2018.
source.label: Gafson 2018 DMF PBMC RNA-seq / NEDA-4 response study

source_terms.license_or_terms_label: CC BY 4.0 article; metadata-only reuse in V50
source_terms.reuse_notes: V50 stores source metadata and a short paraphrased claim only; do not treat article text or conclusions as project-grounded evidence.

why_unverifiable: The project has not yet ingested and rerun the underlying paired expression and NEDA-4 labels under the frozen validation harness.
